_doc: #1672 TEST DATA, not shipped. What the Notify page (communication / my-rss) drew BEFORE #1672 (origin/main 2026-11-12), item by item, and the Notify sub-page (`page`) that draws it AFTER. Only two items may be `removed`, the two the owner named: the C3 Ntfy table and the Channels block. Every other item is `kept` and NotifyPage1672Test finds its test tag (or text) on that sub-page. Entries are only ever added.
